exposure: b-adrenergic blockers (carvedilol, propranolol, metoprolol, atenolol, bisoprolol)
cohort: The study included 158 pregnancies in women with cardiovascular disease at a single center.
finding: As a group, b-adrenergic blockers were significantly associated with fetal growth restriction (FGR), with varying incidence among individual b-blockers, while carvedilol showed no such association.
